protocol.hypothesis: Increasing loss weight for less frequent training families improves family-macro top-five retrieval in a larger catalog without reducing compact-catalog ranking quality.

arms.control: Label-only recipe with uniform row loss.
arms.weighted: Same rows, initialization, order, batch, optimizer, serialization, and masked hard negatives. Multiply losses by normalized inverse-square-root family frequency.

protocol.evaluation: Same 872 development requests across the original 34 tools and all 297 development plus training tools. Training-only distractor relevance is unjudged. Compare within seed using fixed lexical weights. No release holdout scoring.
